67.t: Getting fired by Mario Bauza and learning the Latin beat

67.s: The Barcelona tango band did not influence him; he first subbed with Marcelino Guerra's band around 1945.
67.q: I heard, I liked tango music, because I thought [Canaro] had -- course for the first time hearing a tango band I thought it was very beautiful music, but I never thought -- it never influenced me one way or the other.

67.t: Latin bands: Guerra, Machito and Ricardo Ray
67.s: He found Latin reading challenging, was fired by Machito for not understanding the beat, learned it, went to Japan with Machito, and later spent four years with Ricardo Ray.
67.q: And I worked Martinique, as a substitute with the band. They liked me and I found it interesting, of course everything was reading and it was a a -- challenge. Quite different from reading American scores. So I stayed with them quite awhile. They broke up and then I went with Machito.

67.t: Marcelino Guerra's band and being fired by Machito
